// Code generated by gocpy (Go bridge runtime); DO NOT EDIT.
//
// The Go side of the bridge: a table of handles for Go values passed to
// Gocpy, and a codec for the wire format of std/gobridge. Calls are made
// with reflect from the table fns (bridge.go).
package main

/*
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
*/
import "C"

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"reflect"
	"sort"
	"sync"
	"unicode"
	"unicode/utf8"
	"unsafe"
)

func main() {}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- handles

var (
	hmu   sync.Mutex
	htab  = map[uint64]any{}
	hnext uint64
)

func store(v any) uint64 {
	hmu.Lock()
	hnext++
	h := hnext
	htab[h] = v
	hmu.Unlock()
	return h
}

func load(h uint64) any {
	hmu.Lock()
	v, ok := htab[h]
	hmu.Unlock()
	if !ok {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("gocpy: Go value handle %d is not valid (released or corrupted)", h))
	}
	return v
}

func release(hs []uint64) {
	hmu.Lock()
	for _, h := range hs {
		delete(htab, h)
	}
	hmu.Unlock()
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- entry

//export gocpy_gobrx_dispatch
func gocpy_gobrx_dispatch(id C.int64_t, in unsafe.Pointer, inn C.int64_t, out *unsafe.Pointer, outn *C.int64_t, rel *C.uint64_t, nrel C.int64_t) (st C.int) {
	defer func() {
		if nrel > 0 {
			release(unsafe.Slice((*uint64)(unsafe.Pointer(rel)), int(nrel)))
		}
	}()
	defer func() {
		if v := recover(); v != nil {
			msg := fmt.Sprint(v)
			setOut(out, outn, []byte(msg))
			st = 2
		}
	}()
	var data []byte
	if inn > 0 {
		data = unsafe.Slice((*byte)(in), int(inn))
	}
	d := &decoder{buf: data}
	e := &encoder{}
	call(int(id), d, e)
	setOut(out, outn, e.buf)
	return 0
}

func setOut(out *unsafe.Pointer, outn *C.int64_t, b []byte) {
	*outn = C.int64_t(len(b))
	if len(b) == 0 {
		*out = nil
		return
	}
	m := C.malloc(C.size_t(len(b)))
	copy(unsafe.Slice((*byte)(m), len(b)), b)
	*out = m
}

var errorType = reflect.TypeOf((*error)(nil)).Elem()

func call(id int, d *decoder, e *encoder) {
	switch id {
	case -1: // fmt.Sprint of a handle
		e.str(fmt.Sprint(load(d.u64())))
		return
	case -2: // errors.Is
		a, _ := load(d.u64()).(error)
		b, _ := load(d.u64()).(error)
		e.boolean(errors.Is(a, b))
		return
	case -3: // errors.Unwrap
		a, _ := load(d.u64()).(error)
		encErr(e, errors.Unwrap(a))
		return
	}
	if id < 0 || id >= len(fns) {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("gocpy: unknown Go bridge function %d", id))
	}
	fn := fns[id]
	ft := fn.Type()
	args := make([]reflect.Value, ft.NumIn())
	for i := range args {
		args[i] = decodeStatic(d, ft.In(i))
	}
	var res []reflect.Value
	if ft.IsVariadic() {
		res = fn.CallSlice(args)
	} else {
		res = fn.Call(args)
	}
	if errVars[id] && len(res) == 1 && !res[0].IsNil() {
		addSentinel(id, res[0].Interface().(error))
	}
	for i, r := range res {
		encodeStatic(e, r, ft.Out(i))
	}
}

// Error values of package variables (io.EOF, ...) are sent with the id of
// the variable, so that Gocpy can compare them with ==.
var (
	sentMu    sync.Mutex
	sentinels = map[any]int{}
)

func addSentinel(id int, err error) {
	defer func() { recover() }()
	if !reflect.TypeOf(err).Comparable() {
		return
	}
	sentMu.Lock()
	defer sentMu.Unlock()
	if _, ok := sentinels[err]; !ok {
		sentinels[err] = id
	}
}

func sentinelOf(err error) (id int, ok bool) {
	defer func() {
		if recover() != nil {
			id, ok = 0, false
		}
	}()
	if !reflect.TypeOf(err).Comparable() {
		return 0, false
	}
	sentMu.Lock()
	defer sentMu.Unlock()
	id, ok = sentinels[err]
	return id, ok
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- buffers

type encoder struct{ buf []byte }

func (e *encoder) u64(v uint64)      { e.buf = binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint64(e.buf, v) }
func (e *encoder) byte1(c byte)      { e.buf = append(e.buf, c) }
func (e *encoder) str(s string)      { e.u64(uint64(len(s))); e.buf = append(e.buf, s...) }
func (e *encoder) bytes(b []byte)    { e.u64(uint64(len(b))); e.buf = append(e.buf, b...) }
func (e *encoder) boolean(b bool) {
	if b {
		e.byte1(1)
	} else {
		e.byte1(0)
	}
}

type decoder struct {
	buf []byte
	pos int
}

func (d *decoder) need(n int) {
	if n < 0 || d.pos+n > len(d.buf) {
		panic("gocpy: truncated data from Gocpy")
	}
}
func (d *decoder) u64() uint64 {
	d.need(8)
	v := binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(d.buf[d.pos:])
	d.pos += 8
	return v
}
func (d *decoder) byte1() byte {
	d.need(1)
	c := d.buf[d.pos]
	d.pos++
	return c
}
func (d *decoder) length() int { return int(d.u64()) }
func (d *decoder) str() string {
	n := d.length()
	d.need(n)
	s := string(d.buf[d.pos : d.pos+n])
	d.pos += n
	return s
}
func (d *decoder) bytes() []byte {
	n := d.length()
	d.need(n)
	if n == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	b := make([]byte, n)
	copy(b, d.buf[d.pos:])
	d.pos += n
	return b
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- static types

// mode of a Go type in signatures (must match the generator):
// x error, e empty interface, b/i/u/f/s basic, y []byte, l slice, a array,
// m map, h Go value passed by handle.
func mode(t reflect.Type) byte {
	if t == errorType {
		return 'x'
	}
	switch t.Kind() {
	case reflect.Interface:
		if t.NumMethod() == 0 {
			return 'e'
		}
		return 'h'
	case reflect.Bool:
		return 'b'
	case reflect.Int, reflect.Int8, reflect.Int16, reflect.Int32, reflect.Int64:
		return 'i'
	case reflect.Uint, reflect.Uint8, reflect.Uint16, reflect.Uint32, reflect.Uint64, reflect.Uintptr:
		return 'u'
	case reflect.Float32, reflect.Float64:
		return 'f'
	case reflect.String:
		return 's'
	case reflect.Slice:
		if t.Name() == "" {
			if t.Elem() == byteType {
				return 'y'
			}
			return 'l'
		}
	case reflect.Array:
		if t.Name() == "" {
			return 'a'
		}
	case reflect.Map:
		if t.Name() == "" {
			return 'm'
		}
	}
	return 'h'
}

var (
	byteType = reflect.TypeOf(byte(0))
	anyType  = reflect.TypeOf((*any)(nil)).Elem()
)

func typeName(t reflect.Type) string {
	if t.Kind() == reflect.Pointer && t.Name() == "" && t.Elem().Name() != "" {
		return "*" + typeName(t.Elem())
	}
	if t.Name() != "" && t.PkgPath() != "" {
		return t.PkgPath() + "." + t.Name()
	}
	return t.String()
}

// toHandle stores a Go value for Gocpy. Struct and array values are stored
// as pointers to a copy, so that methods with pointer receivers work.
func toHandle(v reflect.Value) (uint64, string) {
	switch v.Kind() {
	case reflect.Interface:
		if v.IsNil() {
			return 0, ""
		}
		return toHandle(v.Elem())
	case reflect.Pointer, reflect.Map, reflect.Slice, reflect.Chan, reflect.Func:
		if v.IsNil() {
			return 0, ""
		}
		return store(v.Interface()), typeName(v.Type())
	case reflect.Invalid:
		return 0, ""
	}
	p := reflect.New(v.Type())
	p.Elem().Set(v)
	return store(p.Interface()), typeName(v.Type())
}

// fromHandle returns the Go value of a handle as type t.
func fromHandle(h uint64, t reflect.Type) reflect.Value {
	if h == 0 {
		return reflect.Zero(t)
	}
	ov := reflect.ValueOf(load(h))
	ot := ov.Type()
	switch {
	case ot.AssignableTo(t):
		r := reflect.New(t).Elem()
		r.Set(ov)
		return r
	case ot.Kind() == reflect.Pointer && ot.Elem().AssignableTo(t):
		r := reflect.New(t).Elem()
		r.Set(ov.Elem())
		return r
	case t.Kind() == reflect.Pointer && ot.AssignableTo(t.Elem()):
		p := reflect.New(t.Elem())
		p.Elem().Set(ov)
		return p
	}
	panic(fmt.Sprintf("cannot use a Go value of type %s as %s", ot, t))
}

func encErr(e *encoder, err error) {
	if err == nil {
		e.byte1(0)
		return
	}
	if id, ok := sentinelOf(err); ok {
		e.byte1(3)
		e.u64(uint64(id))
	} else {
		e.byte1(1)
	}
	h, name := toHandle(reflect.ValueOf(&err).Elem())
	e.u64(h)
	e.str(name)
	e.str(err.Error())
}

func encodeStatic(e *encoder, v reflect.Value, t reflect.Type) {
	if t == nil {
		return
	}
	switch mode(t) {
	case 'x':
		var err error
		if !v.IsNil() {
			err = v.Interface().(error)
		}
		encErr(e, err)
	case 'e':
		if v.IsNil() {
			e.byte1('n')
			return
		}
		encodeAny(e, v.Elem())
	case 'b':
		e.boolean(v.Bool())
	case 'i':
		e.u64(uint64(v.Int()))
	case 'u':
		e.u64(v.Uint())
	case 'f':
		e.u64(math.Float64bits(v.Float()))
	case 's':
		e.str(v.String())
	case 'y':
		e.bytes(v.Bytes())
	case 'l':
		e.u64(uint64(v.Len()))
		for i := 0; i < v.Len(); i++ {
			encodeStatic(e, v.Index(i), t.Elem())
		}
	case 'a':
		for i := 0; i < v.Len(); i++ {
			encodeStatic(e, v.Index(i), t.Elem())
		}
	case 'm':
		keys := sortedKeys(v)
		e.u64(uint64(len(keys)))
		for _, k := range keys {
			encodeStatic(e, k, t.Key())
			encodeStatic(e, v.MapIndex(k), t.Elem())
		}
	case 'h':
		h, name := toHandle(v)
		e.u64(h)
		e.str(name)
	}
}

func sortedKeys(m reflect.Value) []reflect.Value {
	keys := m.MapKeys()
	sort.Slice(keys, func(i, j int) bool {
		a, b := keys[i], keys[j]
		switch a.Kind() {
		case reflect.Int, reflect.Int8, reflect.Int16, reflect.Int32, reflect.Int64:
			return a.Int() < b.Int()
		case reflect.Uint, reflect.Uint8, reflect.Uint16, reflect.Uint32, reflect.Uint64, reflect.Uintptr:
			return a.Uint() < b.Uint()
		case reflect.Float32, reflect.Float64:
			return a.Float() < b.Float()
		case reflect.String:
			return a.String() < b.String()
		case reflect.Bool:
			return !a.Bool() && b.Bool()
		}
		return fmt.Sprint(a.Interface()) < fmt.Sprint(b.Interface())
	})
	return keys
}

func decodeStatic(d *decoder, t reflect.Type) reflect.Value {
	r := reflect.New(t).Elem()
	switch mode(t) {
	case 'x':
		switch d.byte1() {
		case 1, 3:
			h := d.u64()
			d.str()
			d.str()
			if h != 0 {
				r.Set(reflect.ValueOf(load(h)))
			}
		case 2:
			r.Set(reflect.ValueOf(errors.New(d.str())))
		}
	case 'e':
		if a := decodeAny(d); a.IsValid() {
			r.Set(a)
		}
	case 'b':
		r.SetBool(d.byte1() != 0)
	case 'i':
		r.SetInt(int64(d.u64()))
	case 'u':
		r.SetUint(d.u64())
	case 'f':
		r.SetFloat(math.Float64frombits(d.u64()))
	case 's':
		r.SetString(d.str())
	case 'y':
		r.SetBytes(d.bytes())
	case 'l':
		n := d.length()
		if n > 0 {
			s := reflect.MakeSlice(t, n, n)
			for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
				s.Index(i).Set(decodeStatic(d, t.Elem()))
			}
			r.Set(s)
		}
	case 'a':
		for i := 0; i < t.Len(); i++ {
			r.Index(i).Set(decodeStatic(d, t.Elem()))
		}
	case 'm':
		n := d.length()
		m := reflect.MakeMapWithSize(t, n)
		for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
			k := decodeStatic(d, t.Key())
			m.SetMapIndex(k, decodeStatic(d, t.Elem()))
		}
		r.Set(m)
	case 'h':
		h := d.u64()
		d.str()
		return fromHandle(h, t)
	}
	return r
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- any

// dynDesc writes the descriptor of a dynamic Go type for Gocpy.
func dynDesc(e *encoder, t reflect.Type) {
	switch t.Kind() {
	case reflect.Bool:
		e.byte1('b')
		return
	case reflect.Int, reflect.Int8, reflect.Int16, reflect.Int32, reflect.Int64:
		e.byte1('i')
		e.byte1(byte(t.Kind()))
		return
	case reflect.Uint, reflect.Uint8, reflect.Uint16, reflect.Uint32, reflect.Uint64, reflect.Uintptr:
		e.byte1('u')
		e.byte1(byte(t.Kind()))
		return
	case reflect.Float32, reflect.Float64:
		e.byte1('f')
		e.byte1(byte(t.Size()))
		return
	case reflect.String:
		e.byte1('s')
		return
	case reflect.Interface:
		e.byte1('e')
		return
	case reflect.Slice:
		if t.Name() == "" {
			if t.Elem() == byteType {
				e.byte1('y')
				return
			}
			e.byte1('l')
			dynDesc(e, t.Elem())
			return
		}
	case reflect.Array:
		if t.Name() == "" {
			e.byte1('a')
			e.u64(uint64(t.Len()))
			dynDesc(e, t.Elem())
			return
		}
	case reflect.Map:
		if t.Name() == "" && basicKind(t.Key().Kind()) {
			e.byte1('m')
			dynDesc(e, t.Key())
			dynDesc(e, t.Elem())
			return
		}
	}
	e.byte1('h')
}

func basicKind(k reflect.Kind) bool {
	return k == reflect.Bool || k == reflect.String || (k >= reflect.Int && k <= reflect.Float64)
}

func dynValue(e *encoder, v reflect.Value) {
	t := v.Type()
	switch t.Kind() {
	case reflect.Bool:
		e.boolean(v.Bool())
		return
	case reflect.Int, reflect.Int8, reflect.Int16, reflect.Int32, reflect.Int64:
		e.u64(uint64(v.Int()))
		return
	case reflect.Uint, reflect.Uint8, reflect.Uint16, reflect.Uint32, reflect.Uint64, reflect.Uintptr:
		e.u64(v.Uint())
		return
	case reflect.Float32, reflect.Float64:
		e.u64(math.Float64bits(v.Float()))
		return
	case reflect.String:
		e.str(v.String())
		return
	case reflect.Interface:
		if v.IsNil() {
			e.byte1('n')
			return
		}
		encodeAny(e, v.Elem())
		return
	case reflect.Slice:
		if t.Name() == "" {
			if t.Elem() == byteType {
				e.bytes(v.Bytes())
				return
			}
			e.u64(uint64(v.Len()))
			for i := 0; i < v.Len(); i++ {
				dynValue(e, v.Index(i))
			}
			return
		}
	case reflect.Array:
		if t.Name() == "" {
			for i := 0; i < v.Len(); i++ {
				dynValue(e, v.Index(i))
			}
			return
		}
	case reflect.Map:
		if t.Name() == "" && basicKind(t.Key().Kind()) {
			keys := sortedKeys(v)
			e.u64(uint64(len(keys)))
			for _, k := range keys {
				dynValue(e, k)
				dynValue(e, v.MapIndex(k))
			}
			return
		}
	}
	h, name := toHandle(v)
	e.u64(h)
	e.str(name)
}

func encodeAny(e *encoder, v reflect.Value) {
	if !v.IsValid() {
		e.byte1('n')
		return
	}
	dynDesc(e, v.Type())
	dynValue(e, v)
}

var intTypes = map[byte]reflect.Type{
	2: reflect.TypeOf(int(0)), 3: reflect.TypeOf(int8(0)), 4: reflect.TypeOf(int16(0)), 5: reflect.TypeOf(int32(0)),
	6: reflect.TypeOf(int64(0)), 7: reflect.TypeOf(uint(0)), 8: reflect.TypeOf(uint8(0)), 9: reflect.TypeOf(uint16(0)),
	10: reflect.TypeOf(uint32(0)), 11: reflect.TypeOf(uint64(0)), 12: reflect.TypeOf(uintptr(0)),
}

type gdesc struct {
	tag    byte
	kind   byte
	n      int
	elem   *gdesc
	key    *gdesc
	names  []string
	fields []*gdesc
	typ    reflect.Type
}

func readDesc(d *decoder) *gdesc {
	g := &gdesc{tag: d.byte1()}
	switch g.tag {
	case 'n':
		return g
	case 'b':
		g.typ = reflect.TypeOf(false)
	case 'i', 'u':
		g.kind = d.byte1()
		g.typ = intTypes[g.kind]
		if g.typ == nil {
			panic("gocpy: bad integer kind from Gocpy")
		}
	case 'f':
		g.kind = d.byte1()
		if g.kind == 4 {
			g.typ = reflect.TypeOf(float32(0))
		} else {
			g.typ = reflect.TypeOf(float64(0))
		}
	case 's':
		g.typ = reflect.TypeOf("")
	case 'y':
		g.typ = reflect.TypeOf([]byte(nil))
	case 'e', 'h':
		g.typ = anyType
	case 'l':
		g.elem = readDesc(d)
		g.typ = reflect.SliceOf(g.elem.goType())
	case 'a':
		g.n = d.length()
		g.elem = readDesc(d)
		g.typ = reflect.ArrayOf(g.n, g.elem.goType())
	case 'm':
		g.key = readDesc(d)
		g.elem = readDesc(d)
		g.typ = reflect.MapOf(g.key.goType(), g.elem.goType())
	case 'p':
		g.elem = readDesc(d)
		g.typ = reflect.PointerTo(g.elem.goType())
	case 'r':
		n := d.length()
		var fs []reflect.StructField
		for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
			name := d.str()
			f := readDesc(d)
			g.names = append(g.names, name)
			g.fields = append(g.fields, f)
			if r, _ := utf8.DecodeRuneInString(name); unicode.IsUpper(r) {
				fs = append(fs, reflect.StructField{Name: name, Type: f.goType()})
			}
		}
		g.typ = reflect.StructOf(fs)
	default:
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("gocpy: unknown type descriptor %q from Gocpy", g.tag))
	}
	return g
}

func (g *gdesc) goType() reflect.Type {
	if g.typ == nil {
		return anyType
	}
	return g.typ
}

func (g *gdesc) value(d *decoder) reflect.Value {
	r := reflect.New(g.goType()).Elem()
	switch g.tag {
	case 'n':
		return reflect.Value{}
	case 'b':
		r.SetBool(d.byte1() != 0)
	case 'i':
		r.SetInt(int64(d.u64()))
	case 'u':
		r.SetUint(d.u64())
	case 'f':
		r.SetFloat(math.Float64frombits(d.u64()))
	case 's':
		r.SetString(d.str())
	case 'y':
		r.SetBytes(d.bytes())
	case 'e':
		if a := decodeAny(d); a.IsValid() {
			r.Set(a)
		}
	case 'h':
		h := d.u64()
		d.str()
		if h != 0 {
			r.Set(reflect.ValueOf(load(h)))
		}
	case 'l':
		u := d.u64()
		if u == math.MaxUint64 { // nil slice
			break
		}
		n := int(u)
		s := reflect.MakeSlice(g.typ, n, n)
		for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
			setValue(s.Index(i), g.elem.value(d))
		}
		r.Set(s)
	case 'a':
		for i := 0; i < g.n; i++ {
			setValue(r.Index(i), g.elem.value(d))
		}
	case 'm':
		n := d.length()
		m := reflect.MakeMapWithSize(g.typ, n)
		for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
			k := g.key.value(d)
			v := g.elem.value(d)
			if !v.IsValid() {
				v = reflect.Zero(g.elem.goType())
			}
			if k.IsValid() {
				m.SetMapIndex(k, v)
			}
		}
		r.Set(m)
	case 'p':
		if d.byte1() != 0 {
			p := reflect.New(g.elem.goType())
			setValue(p.Elem(), g.elem.value(d))
			r.Set(p)
		}
	case 'r':
		j := 0
		for i, f := range g.fields {
			v := f.value(d)
			if r0, _ := utf8.DecodeRuneInString(g.names[i]); unicode.IsUpper(r0) {
				setValue(r.Field(j), v)
				j++
			}
		}
	}
	return r
}

func setValue(dst, v reflect.Value) {
	if v.IsValid() {
		dst.Set(v)
	}
}

// decodeAny reads a descriptor and a value (invalid Value for nil).
func decodeAny(d *decoder) reflect.Value {
	g := readDesc(d)
	return g.value(d)
}
